reviews.text:
Gizmo had his first appointment with Dr. Marie Pier Boutin and her amazing team for a consultation.

I have nothing but great things to say about Ophtalmo Vet!

The reception team is very kind and patient over the phone and in person. The clinic itself is very clean and welcoming.

The technicians and support staff were very kind, positive, gentle and caring with Gizmo - they took their time during the tests and took breaks for Gizmo as necessary. I felt they genuinely cared for his safety and well being.

Dr. Boutin is professional but also very warm and empathetic. She takes the time to explain every detail of each procedure and her findings/diagnosis. I left the appointment feeling very positive and worry free. 10/10 experience.

TL;DR: Amazing service and true professionals who clearly love what they do. You won't find the level of empathy and personalized experience anywhere else.

The full story:
Every single member of the staff is loving, friendly, and caring. The receptionist is an absolute sweetheart, incredibly kind and patient. The technicians are warm and genuinely care about how you're feeling and how your dog is doing.

Dr. Olivier is incredibly helpful. He takes the time to explain every step using visual aids and plain language, so you always understand what you're getting into. From the beginning, he made it clear that the surgery was elective and that our dog would live a happy life with or without it. We never felt pressured to get it. He laid out all the pros and cons and gave us plenty of time to think about it. You can tell he and his team are in this profession for the true love of animals.

On the day of the surgery, they showed us where the operation would take place, introduced us to the vets assisting, and explained how everything would unfold. They even sent pictures and updates before, during, and after the procedure. Our dog could see as soon as he woke up from the anesthesia (cataracts had left him fully blind).

He's also diabetic, and the team monitored his glucose regularly and gave him everything he needed (including insulin) to keep him stable throughout.

For post-op care, they set us up for success with a clear schedule, detailed instructions, and all the medications on the spot, so there was no pharmacy run or schedule-making on our end. They welcome photos and emails with any questions or concerns as well, and will do as many follow ups as needed to ensure the recovery process goes as expected.

It's truly a dream team, and I'll never be able to thank them enough for what they did for my dog. I wish every vet clinic had people like this, who genuinely love animals and go above and beyond to ensure their well-being and reassure pet parents. I can't recommend them enough, they've earned all my trust and I only wish they offered regular vet services as well, because I'd gladly bring them all my doggy business!

Always a positive experience with each visit. We've been going there with our pets for years and have always felt supported and well-informed! The best for taking care of our babies' eyes! Thank you, Dr. Ollivier and Dr. De Maria!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Dr. Ollivier is incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and such a pleasure to interact with. He makes it so reassuring to know my cat is in caring and capable hands. The entire clinic staff is amazing—always helpful, welcoming, and professional. Thank you to Dr. Ollivier and the whole team for the wonderful care and for making every visit such a positive experience. Highly recommend!

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience at this clinic with our dog, Fidèle. Everything is very well organized. We particularly appreciated that the animals didn't cross paths, which helped limit stress, aggressive reactions, and the risk of disease transmission.

The entire team made an excellent impression on us, from the very kind and smiling receptionist (whose name I unfortunately don't know) to Dr. Marie-Pier Boutin, who is simply extraordinary.

I felt like she understood our dog's problem as soon as he arrived, even though we had been searching for an answer for over a month. A true magician! Fidèle let herself be examined and listened to her as if he were hypnotized. 😊

A huge thank you to Sarah, the veterinary technician. We have never met a technician who was so attentive, competent, calm, and professional. At first, I even thought she was the vet! 😳

Thank you also to the kind-hearted young man with strong arms who helped us during the examination of our big, scared dog. I think his name is Zachari, but unfortunately, I'm not sure of his real name. His gentleness and help were greatly appreciated.

Throughout the visit, we felt like we were part of a united team, used to working together, where everyone knew what to do. Everything went smoothly and efficiently, and our dog didn't even have time to get tired.

Finally, seeing Fidèle's name on the welcome board touched us deeply. It's a small gesture, but it really warms our hearts: we feel expected ❤️

Thank you to the whole team for your warm welcome and for the attentive care given to our Fidèle!
Truly exceptional. Very good team. Extra.
Very clean and they are very attentive to our needs for our animals
It's always a professional and caring service! Thank you for your dedication ♥️♥️♥️♥️ Kelly and the Paquin family

Wonderful clinic! Exceptional care for our senior girl, really glad we came here for such an expert opinion. The office is welcoming and beautiful, the staff are also some of the best i’ve encountered. No issues with needing english either, really appreciate the work you are all doing!
Very welcoming, and the staff were great too.
The staff are very attentive and gentle with animals.
Warm welcome and very professional team

I woke up one Sunday morning and my dog couldn’t open her eye. At the emergency clinic, the vet saw there was an object in her eye, but they weren’t able to remove it. I called this clinic and they gave me an appointment for the next day.

From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with so much warmth. I was worried, but everyone was smiling, kind, and reassuring, and they quickly made me feel calmer. They were also so caring and affectionate with my dog.

The doctor was excellent and removed the object very quickly. It turned out to be a tiny seashell from the beach! They joked, “Well, she brought you a souvenir,” which made us laugh and made the whole situation feel so much lighter.

She is now on medication and healing well, and I’m very grateful for the care she received. Such a professional, compassionate, and caring team. You can really feel that they love what they do. I highly recommend this clinic!
Warm welcome and a fantastic team, the receptionist was very friendly, thank you!

A very dedicated team, excellent care, and attentive to the owner.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

Another huge WOW!!! A superb team, professional service, competent and warm people who love animals and truly care about their well-being. They took the time to explain everything and reassure us.
Thank you for your warm welcome and highly professional expertise; Zoé is now completely healed.

Exceptional care and service, I've never had such a great experience with my pet 🫶 Dr. Ollivier Franck and his team are wonderful 👌
Blue the bulldog joins me in saying thank you :)

Exceptional service. Very professional and competent. I received sound advice based on my senior dog's needs, not on potential profit. I greatly appreciated their honesty and highly recommend this clinic!

I am endlessly grateful to Dr. Franck Ollivier and the team here! We had an emergency with a corneal ulcer on my dog Chiquita’s eye, and they took incredible care of her. I was so impressed by how organized and efficient the entire clinic was, especially during a stressful situation. Dr. Ollivier acted quickly, handled Chiquita with so much gentle kindness, and immediately put my mind at ease. Thanks to their fast action and expertise, Chiquita is on the mend. I highly recommend this wonderful clinic!
Wonderful experience!!
I really liked the staff and the doctor. A very warm welcome, friendly people, attentive and affectionate with your pet.

Simply wow! The service was impeccable from start to finish. Dr. Marie-Pier Boutin performed surgery on my dog, and just 10 days later, he's as good as new! She and her team did an exceptional job. A huge thank you for the excellent care!

I should give 10 stars! 5 for each eye that Doctors Boutin and De Maria treated perfectly, something my general practitioner couldn't manage (indolent ulcers). All the staff took excellent care of me in clean and welcoming facilities, using state-of-the-art equipment and specialized techniques, all with gentleness, smiles, and plenty of treats! The location is ideal for my humans, close to the highway, with plenty of parking options and refreshments in the waiting room.
He was very professional and inspired confidence in me.
Thank you for the good service and the kindness of the staff at Cooper
Excellent service! Our dog is usually anxious at the vet, but he showed no signs of discomfort during the appointment! The team was very professional; I highly recommend the clinic!

Highly recommend. Our cat had suspected iris melanoma, which is already stressful to accept and deal with, but they helped us every step of the way. They were very human in their approach in dealing with our cat's issue, but also us as owners, and this extended to all the staff working there. They followed our cat for months to help diagnose his condition, they explained the potential risks of the disease, and when it was eventually determined that enucleation was the path forward, they made sure we were well aware of everything: the surgery itself, the risks, the side effects, the after-care. They were always available to answer our questions if something popped up. They walked us through the procedure, how it would be performed, what steps they would take to make it as safe as possible. My beautiful cat is still here, with one less eye but with a better outlook as well. I have only gratitude to express.
Excellent service from the entire team. They were reassuring and provided clear explanations. They take great care of their customers. I highly recommend them.
Excellent care. Very humane. Exceptional welcome, follow-up, and expertise. Thank you.

I am extremely happy that Arthur had both eyes operated on at the Veterinary Ophthalmologist. The professionals are competent, empathetic, and attentive. They were always available to answer our questions. I have never seen a place that provides follow-up care and before-and-after photos; it's exceptional. Thank you, thank you!

I want to express my sincere gratitude for the warm welcome and care my dog ​​received. I particularly appreciated your professionalism and the genuine kindness you showed to my little Emy and me.

I will not hesitate to recommend you to my contacts.

Congratulations! You are exceptional. 😇😻❤️
I would go back tomorrow. Without hesitation. My dog ​​and I have developed complete trust in the entire team.

A clinic filled with compassion.

We received professional service from start to finish.
Dr. Ollivier Frank put us at ease and explained the situation very clearly.

The entire team is stellar and made this a great experience for ourselves and our dog. The explanations were very thorough and great emphasis was put in making sure we got the whole picture, and next steps. We weren't sure what to expect, but now we are 100% sure we made the right decision on choosing Ophtalmo Veterinaire. Thank you so much for the care you showed to Haji!

Extremely disappointing experience with the receptionist. She completely overstepped her bounds by behaving haughtily and lecturing me about my personal medical records. I had received my report and was simply calling to ask if I could get my cat Fleecy's medication. Instead of responding professionally, she became aggressive, telling me curtly that I was no longer allowed to return to the clinic.
I reminded her that I was fully aware of my medical history, that I wasn't requesting a consultation, and that her judgments were unwarranted. I even pointed out that it's perfectly normal not to get along with everyone, but that she had no right to lecture me like that over a simple medication issue. It's regrettable to see such a lack of respect, professionalism, and attentiveness towards clients. Unacceptable customer service.

Chantal
Thank you for your feedback. We remain available to Auclair and you. Dr. Ollivier
Great experience, wonderful staff, techs, and vets. Cannot recommend them enough! Every single visit has been stress free and smooth.
Professional and competent service. All the employees are kind, calm, and efficient. My dog ​​is always well treated, with patience and expertise. The information provided is clear.

I used their services about ten years ago for an ulcer in my boxer's eye (Dr. Olivier) and again this year for an eye injury in my other dog (Dr. Boutin). The service was and still is incredible. Both veterinarians and the entire staff are friendly, calm, compassionate, and professional. I highly recommend them. Thanks again :)
From the moment we arrived, we felt very welcome. When they started evaluating my cat, we were reassured by their professionalism. I am truly satisfied with the care they gave Kia. Thank you.
All the staff are welcoming, kind and very professional.

I highly recommend Clinique vétérinaire d’ophtalmologie and Dr. Olivier Frank.

After researching many veterinary clinics across Montreal, I chose this clinic because I wanted Rosie’s cherry eye to be treated by a true veterinary ophthalmologist. Dr. Frank’s experience, expertise, and research gave me complete confidence from the start.

What stood out to me the most was the day of the surgery. I wasn’t simply dropping Rosie off and picking her up at the end of the day. Before I left, Dr. Frank introduced me to every member of the team who would be caring for her, showed me where she would be staying, and walked me through each step of the procedure and what to expect throughout the day. From the receptionist to the veterinary technicians, everyone was incredibly warm, welcoming, and compassionate.

Less than an hour after I left, I was already receiving photo updates of Rosie, and the team continued to keep me informed throughout the day. That level of communication and transparency gave me so much peace of mind and truly showed how much they care about both their patients and their owners.

During the surgery, Dr. Frank discovered that the cartilage in Rosie’s left eye was longer than normal. Although this wasn’t something that had been identified during the consultation or included in the original surgical plan, he took the time to correct it to ensure the best possible outcome for her recovery. It’s something I never could have seen from the outside, and I’m incredibly grateful for his attention to detail and commitment to providing the highest quality care.

I can’t thank Dr. Olivier Frank and the entire team at Clinique vétérinaire d’ophtalmologie enough. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for specialized eye care for their pet.

Despite receiving bad news about our Maine Coon, Momo, the entire team was incredibly attentive. We were warmly welcomed, and the staff was very caring. His name was already on their board when we arrived, welcoming him as a new patient. The videos explaining how things work at the clinic and where to park are fantastic and really take the stress out of coming to Montreal (which isn't always easy to navigate). After we received the bad news, the ophthalmologist took the time to explain what was happening with our cat and what it would mean for him. They didn't try to run unnecessary tests or charge us for drops that we could only order from veterinarians. It was truly wonderful! Now we know what to expect, and we're going to cherish these last moments with our cat. Thank you for everything!
From beginning to end. Fantastic service. Very professional, compassionate, accommodating and helpful .
An extraordinary and very professional staff; Buck sends you a big hug.
We received compassionate, professional, and attentive service. The team is truly highly competent and offers concrete solutions for our pet's recovery. I recommend them without hesitation.
Excellent service for my dog, thank you for reassuring us

Thank you for the follow-up care and treatment provided for my little Molly. The clinic is very welcoming with excellent receptionists, and what can I say about Dr. Franck Ollivier and Dr. Elisabeth? Thank you again for your wonderful service and the little treats for my little Molly.

Third visit to this clinic. I've been twice for my cat. The second time, I saw Dr. Boutin and received excellent service. Today I went for my dog ​​who has some minor eye problems, and once again, the service was superb, impeccable, and you can really tell they care about our four-legged friends. 🙏💕👌🏻 …

Our Labrador had cataract surgery that had caused him to go blind.
The clinic team was extremely attentive, competent, and available both before and after the operation for our dog.

Today, my little guy has his sight back!

A huge thank you to every member of the team for your immense kindness 🫶

Pitou's family
Thank you for your feedback. We remain available for you and Teddy. Dr. Boutin and Dr. Ollivier
A very good team, attentive and efficient!
Thank you for your kind review. Dr. Ollivier and the rest of the Veterinary Ophthalmology Inc. team.

Excellent end-to-end service for our pet dog. From the warm welcome of front desk reception to the medical staff and eye Doctors all did a great job taking care of our pet’s needs. Thank you from the bottom of our heart! We highly recommend this clinic it is worth travelling from out of town for this petit hospital that has a peaceful clam environment and well equipped with all that is needed for testing and treatment.
Great team ! Knowledgeable vets, great receptionists Louise & Elizabeth. Dr Beaudoin is amazing , energetic , positive and knowledgeable. She helped save our dog’s eye ! Great pet  Ophthalmologist.
Exceptional service!! Kindness, attentiveness, high-quality care, clear and concise explanations. Juliette (red dachshund) thanks you even though she doesn't want your treats!!! 🙃 …

We are so glad we chose this clinic for the excellent care our cat Casper received.
Dr. Franck Ollivier and his team are very kind, professional, and caring.
Well done to the whole team!
A very warm welcome and excellent service from the specialists. Great communication, we felt confident. Thank you to the whole team.
A team of passionate, caring and knowledgeable people! Highly recommended!

Luck and timing to land on a Dr like Dr. Ollivier
The talent in this man is beyond exceptional.
His knowledge, steadfast ability and surgical gift is not something I am capable to fully put into words.
All I can tell you, is that you and your animal are truly safe in his hands.
He performed an incredible surgery on my parents dog Harley who was suffering from glaucoma …. His ability to be kind, understanding but deliver information and a treatment plan and ultimately surgery.
He also looked after my dog Leo and took excellent care.

I must go one step further and compliment his staff-…. his amazing staff.
His staff will transport you through a time warp when service was what it was always meant to be. A proper and professional greeting, follow though with emails, support, a warm greeting, water and cookies for your dog and even a water For you while you go through your troubles .
I cannot compare it to anything because nothing is similar to it without going back in time …

I wish that anyone who is going through this type of issue should always find a Dr. Ollivier and a staff like the ones he has curated

Setting the gold standard

Thank you for everything Dr Ollivier and a special thank you to Louise who took such good care of Harley until we got to him.

An exceptional veterinarian—gentle, attentive, reassuring, and so devoted to her little patients. Her professionalism and compassion make all the difference.

I recommend her without hesitation. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you've done for Nixie! You are simply extraordinary! 🐾💙

My dog was exceptionally well cared for at this clinic. The staff is welcoming, attentive and exceptional at their job  - every detail is thought of, to make both the pet and their owner comfortable throughout. We got clear instructions for every step of the process, were kept updated through every step of the surgery and even received after-hours advice when we had an urgent question - this is something I've never seen here, even with human doctors! Outstanding and highly recommending!
Excellent and very professional service!
Excellent for your dogs eye care.  Very attentive and caring staff.  Great experience with Bentley, dearly departed, and now Charlie.  Highly recommend
Excellent service, fantastic staff, well done!
Thank you for your positive feedback. Dr. Ollivier and the OV team

Very good experience during a very stressful time. The staff are very professional, knowledgeable and kind to the animals (and owners too). Any questions I had afterward were also met with quick response. Price is also reasonable, they don’t cost more than a regular vet visit would, and for this kind of specialized care, it’s 100% worth it
Thank you for this positive review. Dr. Ollivier and the OV team
Thank you for this positive review. Dr. Ollivier and the team at Veterinary Ophthalmology Inc.

They operated on my dog ​​for a neoplasm in his eye. A fantastic team who took care of my dog ​​as if he were their own. I am more than satisfied with the service I received and I highly recommend this team for all animals with eye problems.
thank you for taking care of Bumble and for the clear explanations.

Dr. Ollivier, the veterinarian, should maybe take some anger management classes 😅 It's unbelievable. In Quebec, we experience drastic temperature changes, going from hot to cold in an hour, but he goes from passive-aggressive in two seconds.

I've dealt with Dr. Boutin before and never had a single complaint. However, this other veterinarian clearly told us he was going to ask Google to remove the negative review we had previously left. That speaks volumes about his sensitivity to criticism. If I could have given zero stars, I would have.

Hello Mr. Melendez. We have no Mr. Melendez in our medical records...and if you are truly one of our clients, you haven't provided any details about the reason for your dissatisfaction. Therefore, we cannot process your review and will be asking Google to remove it, as we have no client by that name. Dr. Ollivier and Dr. Boutin.
Excellent service! The team is incredibly attentive and highly qualified. I highly recommend them!
I had a very good experience here. They are soo caring and understanding. Also extremely professional. And they post this cute little sign with there new patients 😍. …

Exceptional service. Dr. Boutin and Dr. Olivier are truly professional. A very friendly team. Trust them. We do with our Molly. The best ophthalmological care with a team sensitive to the needs of our loved ones.

A huge thank you to this exceptional canine ophthalmology team. From beginning to end, we felt supported with tremendous professionalism, gentleness, and empathy.

The work done for our dog was remarkable and very reassuring. We particularly appreciated receiving photos of every stage of the surgery, which allowed us to follow the progress and feel completely confident throughout the entire process. This attention to owners makes a huge difference during such stressful times.

You can feel a genuine love for animals and a sincere concern for the well-being of both the patients and their families. Thank you for the exceptional care, availability, and quality of follow-up. We recommend this clinic without hesitation.

Omgggg!! If ur dog have eye problem go straight to the opthologist! Save u tons of money then a Regular vet! Also the people are very nice and no ptsd with the cost! When all u want is ur dog to heal for the eye and not extra cost for other things come straight here!
The clinic was great, all the employees were very polite and knowledgeable, Dr. Olivier Franke was beyond amazing, thank you to everybody
Thank you for this positive review. Dr. Ollivier and the team at Veterinary Ophthalmology Inc.

Louise gave us a warm welcome at reception, and the team was loving and attentive, taking the time to make the animal comfortable and thoroughly explaining the procedures. You really feel that the animal's well-being is a priority. They even have guest beds for new arrivals. The service exceeded expectations.

I want to sincerely thank you for the excellent care I received today.

Your kindness, professionalism, and attentiveness made all the difference.
You took the time to clearly explain the situation, which was reassuring.
Your team is courteous and dedicated; this is evident from the moment I arrived.
Thank you for everything.
Marlaine and Robert

Well, I'm writing this in Spanish because I'm Mexican.

My experience was 10/10, from the moment we arrived until we left.

1. Clear and effective communication between doctor and patient regarding the diagnosis.

2. Examination: professional and with highly updated equipment.

3. Communication between your veterinarian and the clinic: 10/10.

4. Clear communication at the time of payment.

But most importantly, the way they treated my beautiful son, Fenix, the patience of the staff, and the sweet way they treated him—I loved them!
My son and I are very happy.
Every penny was worth it.
Thank you so much! We love you!

I am extremely happy with Dr. Ollivier and his team. They are so caring and professional. Not a stone left unturned in the care of my pet. Always a pleasure to visit the Clinic. Service is quiet, efficient and professional. I have full confidence in Dr. Olivier and his team: And am happy to have him close by!!
Dr. Olivier gave my pet her sight back........for that I am immeasurably grateful. Amazing Doctor, with a caring and wonderful team to help along. Merci Beaucoup!!
A wonderful team, we are so happy that her surgery went well. She is much more active now. Thank you to your entire amazing team.

Thank you for your warm welcome and kindness.

Today we learned that our little Betty can no longer see. The examination process and the team's compassion made the situation much easier.
Thank you.

Congratulations to the team, services, staff, communication, and explanations. I am very satisfied with my consultation and very happy to have met an ophthalmologist who clearly loves their work. Go and support them if you need eye care for your dog. It's a 10/10.
Thank you, we remain available for you and Méo. Dr. Ollivier

I've been going to this veterinary ophthalmology clinic for nine years with my cat. The vets are wonderful and have always taken excellent care of my cat, who has had recurring ulcers, and I'm very satisfied with their services. They're also very honest; Dr. Olivier even saved my cat from surgery. Thank you for your excellent service. A big thank you also to Louise, the receptionist.
